usage:
skywalker 0.1.0 — a game engine built for AI agents

usage:
  skywalker mcp [--project DIR] [--scene FILE]   MCP server on stdio
  skywalker mcp --attach [SOCKET]                bridge to a running editor
  skywalker mcp --auto [--project DIR]           bridge to the editor if it runs, else headless
  skywalker serve [--project DIR] [--scene FILE] [--socket PATH] [--lifeline]
                                                 headless engine serving the agent socket (like the editor)
  skywalker setup <claude|codex|gemini|cursor|all> [--project DIR] [--global] [--dry-run] [--print] [--no-skills]
                                                 install the MCP server entry, skills, subagents and commands
  skywalker render SCENE -o out.png [--width W] [--height H] [--annotate] [--scene-camera] [--samples N]
  skywalker run SCENE [--ticks N] [-o out.png]
  skywalker check FILE.wander [--project DIR] [--disassemble] [--format]
  skywalker call TOOL [JSON] [--scene FILE] [--project DIR] [-o image.png]
  skywalker call TOOL [JSON] --attach [--as NAME] [--socket PATH]   (on the running editor)
  skywalker tools [--markdown|--json] [--project DIR]
  skywalker studio status|agents|board|feedback|loops --project DIR
  skywalker studio run --project DIR --loop NAME [--iterations N] [--dry-run] [--yes]
  skywalker build --project DIR --out DIR [--name N] [--icon F.png] [--release] [--all-assets]   package a macOS app
  skywalker movie SCENE [JSON] -o out.mp4 [--sequence S] [--resolution 1080p] [--fps N] [--samples N]
                    [--shutter F] [--simulate] [--clay|--sketch] [--resume] ...   render a cinematic (movie --help)
  skywalker legal [terms|privacy|license|licensing] [--accept] [--status] [--json]
                                                 Terms of Use, Privacy Notice, license; --accept records acceptance
  skywalker version

commands.build:
usage: skywalker build --project DIR --out DIR [options]

Builds DIR/<Name>.app: the player, the scenes, the assets they reference, scripts, the compiled native
module, Info.plist, icon and an ad-hoc code signature. Settings come from the project's game.json.

options:
  --project DIR     the project (default: current directory)
  --out DIR         folder to write the app into (required)
  --name NAME       app name (default: game.json title)
  --icon FILE.png   app icon, 1024x1024 recommended (default: game.json icon)
  --release         strip the player's symbols (smaller app)
  --all-assets      ship every asset, not only the referenced ones
  --version X.Y.Z   --bundle-id com.you.game   --scene FILE   override game.json
  --no-sign         skip the ad-hoc code signature
  --no-native       do not compile native/*.cpp
  --player PATH     player executable to bundle (default: skywalker-player next to this binary)
  --dry-run         list what would ship; write nothing
  --json            machine-readable report
commands.movie:
usage: skywalker movie SCENE [JSON] [options]

Renders a cinematic offline: a sequence, an inline camera path (JSON "camera") or the scene camera.
JSON takes every movie_render argument; the options below override it.

options:
  --project DIR        the project (default: current directory)
  -o, --output PATH    .mp4 (H.264), .mov (ProRes 422 HQ) or a folder / name_####.png (repeatable)
  --codec C            codec of the -o before it: h264 | hevc | prores | prores4444 | png
  --bitrate MBPS       H.264 / HEVC bitrate of the -o before it
  --sequence NAME      sequence entity or .sequence.json
  --camera-entity NAME look through this camera
  --start S --end S --duration S   time range in seconds
  --fps N              24 (default), 30, 60...
  --resolution R       720p | 1080p (default) | 1440p | 4k   (or --width W --height H)
  --samples N          samples per frame (default 8)
  --shutter F          motion blur: open fraction of the frame (0.5 = 180 degrees)
  --shutter-samples N  sub-frames across the shutter
  --simulate           run the game simulation (scripts, physics)
  --clay | --sketch    clay or pencil-sketch look
  --quality Q          full | balanced | fast
  --warmup N           frames rendered before the first one (default 4)
  --resume             continue an interrupted PNG sequence
  --quiet              no progress lines
Ctrl-C stops after the current sub-frame; written frames and the video so far are kept.
commands.setup:
usage: skywalker setup <claude|codex|gemini|cursor|all> [options]

Installs the MCP server entry (pointing at this binary), the skywalker-* skills, studio-role subagents,
workflow commands and a guidance block for the tool. Existing configs are merged, never replaced;
files that change are backed up under <root>/.skywalker/setup-backups/.

options:
  --project DIR   project to configure (default: current directory)
  --global        configure your user-level config (~/.claude, ~/.codex, ~/.gemini, ~/.cursor) instead
  --dry-run       show what would change (with diffs); write nothing
  --print         print the MCP entry to paste by hand; write nothing
  --no-skills     only the MCP server entry
  --mode MODE     auto (default: editor if running, else headless), attach, or headless
  --binary PATH   path to write for the skywalker executable (default: this binary)
  --home DIR      use DIR as the home directory for --global (for tests); external commands are printed, not run
  --verbose       list every file instead of a summary
commands.studio:
usage: skywalker studio status|agents|board|feedback|loops --project DIR
       skywalker studio run --project DIR --loop NAME [--iterations N] [--goal TEXT]
                            [--dry-run | --mock SCRIPT.json] [--yes] [--scene FILE] [--no-save] [--verbose]
commands.serve:
usage: skywalker serve [--project DIR] [--scene FILE] [--socket PATH] [--lifeline] [--quiet]
  A headless engine serving the agent socket (like the editor). Attach with
  `skywalker mcp --attach PATH`, the Python agent layer (sky-agents), or `call --attach --socket PATH`.
commands.legal:
usage: skywalker legal [terms|privacy|license|licensing] [--accept] [--status] [--json]

Prints Skywalker's Terms of Use, Privacy Notice and license summary (the copies embedded in this binary).
Nothing is sent anywhere; automation never waits for acceptance.

  terms|privacy|license|licensing   print one document (license = full LICENSE text,
                                    licensing = plain-language summary and third-party notices)
  --accept    record that you accept the Terms of Use and acknowledge the Privacy Notice
              (for headless and CI use; the editor asks on first launch)
  --status    versions and acceptance state only
  --json      machine-readable output (the legal_info tool payload)
